name: Baked Cinnamon-Sugar Flour Tortilla Crisps
whyItWorks: Easily beats corn tortilla chips (which have sharp, un-ground corn kernel edges).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brush a soft white flour tortilla with melted butter, sprinkle generously with cinnamon and sugar, cut into triangles, and bake in the toaster oven at 375F for 5 minutes until crisp.
